Kept the UNDERSTAND narrative chapters (History, NYC Table, Arts Scene, City Skyline, Queer City, NYC on Screen). Photo-credit caption lines stripped; address/transit '( MAP GOOGLE MAP ...)' lines preserved for geocoding/trigger_address.
